text:
sarah: Quick follow-up from the INC-438 postmortem — we still have a few open remediation items that are now past their target dates. @ajay @mike @emily can you post status updates here by EOD?

sarah: Current open items (copied from the postmortem):
```
- AJ-12: finish retry backoff in router (owner: ajay) — target 2026-03-10
- MK-07: validate autoscale thresholds and add guardrails (owner: mike) — target 2026-03-12
- EM-05: add alert for KV cache evictions with sample traces (owner: emily) — target 2026-03-14
```

ajay: on AJ-12 — PR is open, addressing a flakey test. ETA tomorrow morning, sorry for the slip.

mike: MK-07 — hit a blocker with the metric dimensions we get from the new exporter. Filed INF-684, pinged @eng-infra. I can do the thresholds once INF-684 returns.

oncall-bot: Reminder: INC-438 remediation items past due. Items: AJ-12, MK-07, EM-05. Auto-reminder sent to owners.

sarah: @mike @ajay if you expect more than 48h on blockers, flag it here so we can reassign or escalate. We've seen this pattern two incidents in a row — need to avoid drift.

lei: @sarah +1 on escalation. If AJ-12 or MK-07 aren't at least in progress with an actionable next step by EOD, I'll reassign temporary owners to keep timeline. :eyes:

emily: EM-05 done — added metric, alert, and a sample trace attached to the alert payload. Deployed to staging. Commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/commit/7a1b2c3

ajay: quick update — PR link: https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/pull/142. The flaky test is due to timing; adding a small refactor + integration assertion. Will finish and merge tomorrow AM (1772012155).

mike: INF-684 updated, eng-infra says they can provide the missing dimension by tomorrow afternoon. I'll pair with @eng-infra then and push thresholds same day. If that slips I'll call out a temporary threshold.

sarah: Thanks. Two asks before I close the loop: 1) reply with the PR/commit link when merged, 2) mark the postmortem action item status in the doc (INTERNAL PM tracker).

mike: will do. If eng-infra blocks after tomorrow I'll raise an internal incident and copy @lei.

lei: Good. Once AJ-12 and MK-07 have PRs/commits linked here, I'll verify and update the incident status to "remediated".

ajay: merged now, commit 3f4e1b2 — fixes the backoff + adds a unit test. https://git.internal/r/redwood/router/commit/3f4e1b2

mike: added temporary threshold and created MK-07-epic for follow-up with eng-infra. Commit: https://git.internal/r/redwood/ops/commit/55b2aa9. Will replace temp threshold once eng-infra delivers.

sarah: Verified AJ-12 and MK-07 links, EM-05 already verified. Closing chase: marking remediation items updated in the postmortem doc and tagging owners as complete-to-verified. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:

sarah: If anything regresses, reopen INC-438 or open INF-... and ping #incidents.
